subject: AcmeHealth - Private/VPC discovery recap & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Rebecca Turner <rebecca.turner@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: AcmeHealth - Private/VPC discovery recap & next steps

Hi Rebecca 

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and proposed next steps so we’re all aligned. If I missed anything, please flag it and we’ll update.

What we heard (pain/drivers):
- Regulatory requirement for data residency and strict access controls (HIPAA + state-specific rules).
- Preference for a Private/VPC deployment with customer-managed networking; eventual interest in an on-prem air-gapped option for certain workloads.
- Concern about egress exposure and strict firewall/allowlist policies; want predictable latency for clinical workflows.
- Need for audit logs, KMS integration, and SOC 2 evidence for procurement.

Goals:
- Proof-of-concept w/ private VPC deployment for a non-production dataset (3-4 week timeline).
- Validate network topology, connectivity (AWS Transit Gateway / VPC peering options), and performance SLA targets.
- Confirm security posture: KMS, audit logs, data retention policy.

Key constraints / technical notes from the call:
- AcmeHealth networking: strict outbound restrictions, no publicly routable endpoints from clinical subnet; egress must go through a proxy cluster.
- Some teams require data to remain in the US-East region for residency.
- Potential air-gap requirement for future pilot (disconnected environment).

Attachments I'm including: our Private/VPC deployment checklist, a short SOC 2 summary, and a networking requirements template to capture your firewall/proxy details.

Proposed next steps (please confirm availability):
1) Schedule 60-min technical deep dive with your network and security leads (Michael + Dev to join) — suggested slots next Tue/Wed morning PT.
2) You to share the completed networking template and any current diagram (we’ll review and call out any missing items).
3) Redwood to produce a tailored mutual action plan (timeline, access, PoC success criteria, and SOW/estimate) within 3 business days after the deep dive.

Thanks 

Marissa Cole
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123
Redwood Inference

--

From: Rebecca Turner <rebecca.turner@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Li <tom.li@acmehealth.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AcmeHealth - Private/VPC discovery recap & next steps

Thanks Marissa 

This is great and captures the conversation. A couple clarifications from my side: 

- For the PoC we can allow a private VPC endpoint that accepts connections from our clinical-subnet via our proxy cluster. We cannot have any publicly routable endpoints from that subnet.
- Data residency: agree to US-East for the PoC and likely production as well.
- Air-gap: not required for the PoC, but we need a plan and rough cost/schedule if we pursue an air-gapped deployment later.

Next steps on our side:
- I’ll loop in our SecurityOps engineer (Tom) to the technical deep dive. He’ll also upload the current network diagram and firewall rules to the template you sent.
- We’ll need your SOC 2 Type II report and any documentation around KMS/HSM integrations before procurement can move forward.

Availability: Tue 11/3 10-11am PT or Wed 11/4 9-10am PT work for us for the deep dive.

Appreciate the clear plan 

— Rebecca
VP, Product Strategy | AcmeHealth
rebecca.turner@acmehealth.com

--

From: Tom Li <tom.li@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rebecca Turner <rebecca.turner@acmehealth.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Oct 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AcmeHealth - Private/VPC discovery recap & next steps

Thanks all 

I’ve uploaded our current network diagram and firewall/export rules to the template Rebecca, and I’ll be on the Wed 9-10am PT deep dive. A couple items I want to confirm for the session so you can prepare:

- We require TLS mutual auth from service endpoints coming into our proxy cluster.
- Outbound egress from the proxy is restricted to a small set of IPs (we’ll list them in the template).
- We’ll want to validate that the KV cache and any LLM caching does not persist PHI beyond a configurable TTL; please be prepared to discuss retention and scrub policies.

Look forward to the call.

— Tom
